newsitem.title: MALAWI: BRITAIN GRANTS MALAWI 15 MILLION POUNDS IN AID.
newsitem.headline: BRITAIN GRANTS MALAWI 15 MILLION POUNDS IN AID.

text.p: The British government pledged 15 million pounds in aid to Malawi to boost its social programmes, its High Commission said on Wednesday.

"We will be working in partnership with the Malawi government to ensure that effective and affordable public services, essential elements in the fight against poverty, are part of all programmes funded by our government," the High Commission said in a statement.

It said the pledge was part of the government's commitment to increasing its support for human development in the areas of health, education and provision of clean water in Africa for the next three years.
